name: Discord presence
description: What your agents are doing, on your Discord profile — the project, how many are working, and which one is waiting on you

applicationId.label: Application ID
applicationId.description: The id of a Discord application you own — discord.com/developers/applications, General Information. Its name is the line Discord prints above the presence.

showProject.label: Show the project name
showProject.description: Off puts `aimux` there instead. Repository names are the part of this that leaves your machine.

largeImage.label: Art asset key
largeImage.description: Name of an image uploaded under Rich Presence → Art Assets. Empty shows no icon.
